_comment: Symbols scheduled for deletion by P9 (10-cleanup), consumed by scripts/verify/deadcode_report.php. Sibling of expected_diffs.json / expected_command_diffs.json. A symbol is GREEN when it has ZERO blocking call sites: matches in its own defining file, under tests/, and in any path listed in its allowed_callers are not blocking. GREEN means 'safe to delete'; it is a PRECONDITION of the deletion, never a record that the deletion happened.
